summary: Bangkok school teaching Thai language through private classes for conversation, reading and writing, and test preparation.

facts.label: Class format
facts.value: One-on-one lessons seven days a week at the school, or at the student's home or office
facts.quote: One-on-one lessons run seven days a week on the school's premises, but can also be arranged to take place at the student's home or office

facts.label: Test preparation
facts.value: Preparation for the Ministry of Education Thai Competency Test
facts.quote: preparation for the Ministry of Education’s Thai Compentency Test

facts.label: Location
facts.value: 2nd and 3rd floor of Y.M.C.A., Sukhumvit Soi 42, near BTS Ekamai
facts.quote: 2nd & 3rd Floor of Y.M.C.A., Sukhumvit Soi 42 (Near BTS Ekamai)
